note: llama.cpp release b11763 is the commit the macOS build is pinned to (b38960f5 is b11763 plus one CI-only commit). Hashes are the release assets' sha256 digests as published by the GitHub release API on 27 October 2026; the installer refuses a file that does not match.

cpu.note: any x64 PC; a 2B vision model answers in tens of seconds on the CPU

vulkan.note: NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs with a Vulkan driver

cuda.note: NVIDIA GPUs; the second archive carries the CUDA 12.4 runtime DLLs
